response.justification: Bogdan brings genuine staff-level experience, deep TypeScript/JavaScript expertise, and hands-on exposure to distributed, high-throughput systems (e.g., micro-services handling millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby, AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling at re:cinq). However, the resume shows no evidence of Python experience, which is an explicit must-have, and lacks clear signals of formal on-call/incident-response ownership or agile ceremony participation, making the fit uncertain despite strong architectural and systems-thinking credentials.
strengths: Proven distributed systems and high-throughput experience (millions of HTTP requests/sec, low-latency async I/O work)
Current hands-on work with AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic developer tooling
Long track record of staff/senior-level technical leadership across diverse stacks and company stages
concerns: No mention of Python anywhere in skills or work history, despite it being a core must-have
No explicit evidence of on-call rotations, incident response, or formal operational ownership
Agile/scrum methodology experience is only implied via TDD/CI/CD, not explicitly demonstrated (e.g., scrum champion, sprint ceremonies)
